items.title: Jerry Bergonzi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 7, 2022
items.q: one of the guys in the band is going to get sick... Dave’s son, and we canceled the trip. Dave Brubeck’s son.

ctx.x: Anything you feel like sharing? © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

Well I can remember studying the stars in Peru and I’d even see the shape of the windows that I was — I mean where I’d go look at it, investigating. It was exactly what I saw. And another one I remember a woman who used to — I used to go to a psychic and she said to me, “You’re going to go on four trips this year but one’s getting canceled because one of the people in the band — you’re going overseas four times this year but one of the guys in the band is going to get sick.” And one of the guys did get sick,…

Um hum. Very interesting. The other day I heard John Coltrane’s “A Love Supreme” part of it. They played part of it on Sirius radio. And I started thinking about the certain decades of jazz. And it seems like for much of jazz there was a social connection that went with the music and I’m not sure I’m correct about this but in the 30s you had a dance and entertainment element. In the 50s — when I think of the 50s I think of you know there’s this sort of hipster — Dizzy Gillespie with the beret, like there’s a hip-…
